intro.text: A seon that Raoden handed to Dashe after Elantris was restored, and that Dashe gave to his daughter Matisse.

items.text: Aeo and another seon, Ati, had both lost their masters, who died after the Reod but before Elantris was restored. Once the two seons had recovered, Raoden passed them on to Dashe, who kept Ati and gave Aeo to Matisse. The name comes from the Aon for bravery, and Raoden and Ashe both thought it a fitting match for her.
